selected_story_titles: NASA ends NICER science operations after an internal pointing-motor failure
Terra will stop collecting Earth-science data on 1 December after 27 years
ClearSpace-1 enters construction for a planned 2030 debris-removal demonstration
An interpretable decision tree guides high-field superconducting-film growth
Pooled human microglia models connect neurodegeneration loci to cellular phenotypes
A Chinese-population multi-omics atlas broadens molecular-trait mapping
LLM-written discharge summaries pass a retrospective clinician noninferiority test
Nuclear quadrupole resonance monitors reactions inside a working ball mill
North Atlantic deep water expanded during the onset of Northern Hemisphere glaciation

checks.result: NICER, Terra, ClearSpace-1 and the peer-reviewed EuBCO film-optimization result were selected. Transient alerts were excluded to the alerts part; routine seminars, outreach and future media events were not selected.
No same-window item passed both significance and primary-source-verification thresholds.
Interpretable superconducting-film optimization and clinical discharge-summary evaluation were selected; claims were bounded to the tested systems and retrospective design.
Pooled microglial functional genomics and the Chinese-population multi-omics atlas were selected. Cellular and Mendelian-randomization results were not described as demonstrated disease causation.
Operando BM-NQR and interpretable EuBCO-film growth were selected as method and experimental materials advances.
North Atlantic deep-water reconstruction and Terra's mission-end milestone were selected. No same-window palaeontology item received sufficient primary-source depth for selection.
Microglial functional genomics and the LLM discharge-summary study were selected. No treatment efficacy was inferred from cell models or retrospective document ratings.

access_gaps: Detailed supplementary proxy-sensitivity analyses for the North Atlantic deep-water reconstruction were not accessible at the cutoff; the story is limited to the peer-reviewed abstract and indexed results.
Some institutional and journal archive pages were dynamically loaded and could not be exhaustively enumerated.
No claim of exhaustive journal coverage or verified absence in unselected fields is made.
